title: Pokémon TCG Tyranitar V Sword & Shield Battle Styles 097/163 Holo Ultra Rare
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Tyranitar V card from the Pokémon TCG features the Darkness attribute and a V rarity. It is part of the Battle Styles set and has an ultra-rare holo finish. With an impressive 230 HP, this basic stage Pokémon card is a must-have for any collector or player.

The card is in English language and features artwork by Ayaka Yoshida. It has a card number of 097/163 and is manufactured by The Pokémon Company. This card is perfect for anyone looking to add a powerful and rare card to their collection or deck.
